messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Error in estimateKappa() from PSCBS
parts:
Just a follow up to the mailing list on this one, I'll paste my
offline reply to Oscar below:

Unfortunately, there is nothing much one can do about this sample (see
attached figure); there is most likely nothing going and everything is
all normal (1,1) PSCNs, leaving nothing for the estimator to rely on.
It needs some aberrations to work.

If I haven't said it before, it's on our wishlist to be able to "call"
such samples, but it's not clear exactly how it should be done.

Cheers,

Henrik

On Wed, Jul 31, 2013 at 1:27 AM, Oscar Rueda <Oscar...@cruk.cam.ac.uk> wrote:
